title: bug: on Linux and macOS the installed moe-daemon bin (the npm bin symlink that npm install -g, npm link and npx create) never runs main(), because index.ts's entry guard compares import.meta.url with the symlink path in argv[1]; every subcommand prints nothing and exits 0, so `moe-daemon check-architecture` passes a forbidden import and moe-agent.sh's daemon autostart, which prefers moe-daemon on PATH, dies with "Daemon process exited unexpectedly"
description:
Filed by hunt #21 (task-e5d38de9, architect-2a219562) on 2026-11-04. The evidence came from lane 3 (the check-architecture CLI). Re-verified with a real npm install.

PROBLEM
- packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:1288 runs main() only when `import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href`.
  - Node loads the main module by its real path. process.argv[1] keeps the path the shell ran.
  - Off Windows, npm's bin-links makes the package bin (package.json:50-51, "moe-daemon": "./dist/index.js") a symlink:
    - PREFIX/bin/moe-daemon -> ../lib/node_modules/moe-daemon/dist/index.js, for npm install -g and npm link;
    - node_modules/.bin/moe-daemon, for npx and a local install.
  - So the guard is false, main() never runs, and the process exits 0 with no output.
- Every subcommand is inert: version, start, init, stop, status, doctor, accounts and check-architecture.
- Windows is not affected, because npm writes .cmd/.ps1 shims there that run node on the real file. The moe-proxy bin is not affected either: packages/moe-proxy/src/index.ts has no entry guard.
- The guard dates from ebb4bf3d (2026-05-14).

Who hits it:
- packages/moe-daemon/README.md:8 (`npm install -g moe-daemon`) and :13 (`npx moe-daemon start --project ...`), the documented install.
- scripts/install-mac.sh:143-148. `--global` runs `npm link` in the daemon and proxy packages, and :223 then uses `moe-daemon` for the launchd setup.
- scripts/moe-agent.sh:1955-1956 prefers `moe-daemon` on PATH for its daemon autostart, when MOE_DAEMON_PATH is unset and the runtime is not protected. The inert bin exits 0 at once, no daemon.json appears, and :1996 prints "Daemon process exited unexpectedly" and exits 1.
- The JetBrains MOE_DAEMON_COMMAND override. docs/CONFIGURATION.md:60's example is `npx moe-daemon`, honoured since 8383080c, and on Linux/macOS it starts nothing.
- The installed checker form `moe-daemon check-architecture` (delivery/requiredChecks.ts:33 INSTALLED_ARCHITECTURE_CHECK; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:388 and :440). As a qualityGate or required check it exits 0 for any candidate, so the gate records "passed". This fails open.

EVIDENCE (HEAD acea850b; snapshot /tmp/hunt-e5d3-snap, dist built with `npx tsc -p .`)
- `bash /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-e5d38de9/mine/repro-npm-global-bin.sh`; its output is repro-npm-global-bin.out next to it.
  - A real `npm install -g --prefix <tmp> --offline <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon` creates `moe-daemon -> ../lib/node_modules/moe-daemon/dist/index.js`.
  - The repo's HEAD adds a forbidden src/ui -> src/db import. Results:
    - `node <pkg>/dist/index.js version`: exit=0, stdout `0.8.0`.
    - `moe-daemon version`: exit=0 stdout_bytes=0 stderr_bytes=0.
    - `node <pkg>/dist/index.js check-architecture --rules arch.json`: exit=1, one JSON line with `"violations":[{"ruleId":"ui-no-db",...}]` and outcome failed.
    - `moe-daemon check-architecture --rules arch.json`: exit=0 stdout_bytes=0 stderr_bytes=0.
    - `moe-daemon start --project <repo>`: exit=0 stdout_bytes=0, and no daemon.json is written.
- Vitest repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-e5d38de9/B/installedBinSymlink.test.ts, with its output in vitest-installedBinSymlink.out.
  - It fails 2/2 at HEAD and passes 2/2 against the real path.
  - It symlinks <tmp>/prefix/bin/moe-daemon -> src/index.ts and spawns `process.execPath --import tsx <link> version`, the same pattern as src/index.version.test.ts. Expected "0.8.0\n"; received "" with status 0.
  - It also spawns `... check-architecture --rules arch.json`. Expected {status:1, lines:1, outcome:'failed'}; received {status:0, lines:0}.

FIX DIRECTION
- index.ts:1288: decide "is main" on real paths. For example, a small exported helper `isMainModule(argv1, moduleUrl)` returns `fs.realpathSync.native(argv1) === fs.realpathSync.native(fileURLToPath(moduleUrl))`, and false on any error, so an absent argv[1] still never runs main and importing index.ts from tests never starts the daemon.
- Alternatively, ship a dedicated bin entry that imports and runs main, and point package.json bin at it. The realpath guard is the smaller change.
- Keep the main().catch(...) body as it is.
- No README, installer or launcher change is needed once the bin works.

HUNK OWNERSHIP: this row owns only the entry guard block at index.ts:1288-1293 and any helper it adds. main()'s dispatch (:1206-1253) belongs to the sibling check-architecture dispatch row filed alongside this one. Do not edit it here.

FILES: packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts (entry guard only) and packages/moe-daemon/src/index.bin.test.ts (new). No open row holds index.ts (lanes.js, 2026-11-04 09:30Z). No launcher file is touched.

GATE: vitest in packages/moe-daemon, run in a snapshot outside the shared checkout (global rail).
definitionOfDone: Through a symlink to the entry (<tmp>/bin/moe-daemon -> src/index.ts, run as `node --import tsx <link> ...`), `version` prints the package version and exits 0, and `check-architecture --rules arch.json` on a fixture whose HEAD adds a forbidden import prints one JSON line with outcome "failed" and exits 1. A new test in packages/moe-daemon/src/index.bin.test.ts pins this; it is skipped on win32 (symlinks need privileges there) and fails at acea850b.

Running the entry by its real path still works, and importing index.ts from a test still never starts main(). `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/index.bin.test.ts src/index.version.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/index.relativeProject.test.ts src/commands/checkArchitecture.test.ts` exits 0 in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

After `npm install -g --prefix <tmp> --offline <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon`, `<tmp>/bin/moe-daemon version` prints the version. Re-running /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-e5d38de9/mine/repro-npm-global-bin.sh on the fixed snapshot shows cases B, D and E with output (B prints the version, D exits 1 with the violation line, E writes daemon.json), not exit=0 with stdout_bytes=0.

Imports: spawnSync and execFileSync (node:child_process), fs, createRequire (node:module), os, path, fileURLToPath and pathToFileURL (node:url), vitest, `isEntryModule` from './index.js' (added in step 2), VERSION from './util/version.js'.

Constants:
- entrypoint = fileURLToPath(new URL('./index.ts', import.meta.url)).
- tsx = pathToFileURL(createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('tsx')).href. Do not use a bare `--import tsx`: the B2 child runs with its cwd in a fixture repo.
- RULES/FORBIDDEN: the state-no-tools rule and the `import { t } from '../tools/t.js'` line, as in src/commands/checkArchitecture.test.ts:14-16.

Helpers:
- cleanEnv(): process.env without MOE_* and GIT_* keys.
- git()/commit(): copy them from checkArchitecture.test.ts:19-40, where they are module-local. GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL is /dev/null here because these rows are POSIX-only.
- cli(entry, args, cwd, env = cleanEnv()) = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--import', tsx, entry, ...args], { cwd, env, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 60_000 }).

Top-level beforeEach/afterEach: tmp = fs.realpathSync(fs.mkdtempSync(<os.tmpdir()>/moe-bin-)). macOS's tmpdir is a symlink, hence the realpath. link = <tmp>/prefix/bin/moe-daemon. Remove tmp afterwards.

Row titles must start with 'B1: ', 'B2: ', 'B3a: ' and so on, because the gate counts '✓ .*> B[1-3][a-e]?: '.

(1) describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')('installed bin: an npm bin symlink to the entry'). Symlinks need privileges on Windows. Its beforeEach does mkdirSync(dirname(link)) and fs.symlinkSync(entrypoint, link).
- B1: run `version` through the link, with cwd tmp and env MOE_PROJECT_PATH set to an empty <tmp>/project, as src/index.version.test.ts does.
  - Expect result.error undefined, and {status, stdout, stderr} toEqual {0, `${VERSION}\n`, ''}.
  - The project dir stays empty.
- B2: build a fixture repo <tmp>/repo:
  - git init;
  - base commit: arch.json=RULES, src/state/s.ts, src/tools/t.ts;
  - candidate commit: src/state/s.ts=FORBIDDEN.
  Run ['check-architecture','--rules','arch.json'] with cwd repo through BOTH the entrypoint (the control: it proves the fixture fails) and the link. For each: {status, lines} toEqual {1, 1}, and the parsed line's {outcome, violations[0].ruleId} toEqual {'failed', 'state-no-tools'}. Then the link's stdout toBe the entrypoint's stdout.
- Give each of these two rows a 60_000 test timeout. Every tsx spawn takes 1-5 s, and index.version.test.ts is a known load flake at the 5 s default.

(2) describe('isEntryModule') with moduleUrl = pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(entrypoint)).href:
- B3a: undefined and '' are both false.
- B3b: the entry's real path is true.
- B3c: it.skipIf(win32). A symlink to the entry, created at `link`, is true.
- B3d: the test file's own path, fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), is false.
- B3e: path.join(tmp, 'no-such-moe-entry.js') is false and does not throw. This row pins the error handling.

implementationPlan.description:
The fix (DoD 1 and 2). In packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts, edit ONLY the entry guard block at the end of the file: today's `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {` at :1288. The reference diff is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-e5d38de9/proto-d63e3dba/index.ts.patch (+18/-1); apply it with your own Edit tool.

Directly above the guard, add `export function isEntryModule(argv1: string | undefined, moduleUrl: string): boolean`:
- `if (!argv1) return false;`
- then `if (moduleUrl === pathToFileURL(argv1).href) return true;` This is today's comparison and it runs first, so every run that works today takes the same branch: the IDE's `node <abs>/dist/index.js start`, the launchers, the supervisor's `_run` child.
- then `try { return moduleUrl === pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(argv1)).href; } catch { return false; }`
- Error handling: a realpath failure (ENOENT, EACCES, ELOOP) returns false, never throws. A throw here would crash every import of index.ts.
- Use fs.realpathSync, NOT .native: Node's own main-entry resolution (toRealPath) uses the JS realpathSync, so this reproduces import.meta.url's exact casing and 8.3 form on Windows. `fs` (:7) and `pathToFileURL` (:13) are already imported.
- Doc comment, 4-6 lines, the why only: npm's bin is a symlink off Windows (npm install -g, npm link, npx), and Node loads the main module by its real path, so argv[1] as written can name a link while import.meta.url names its target. Any error means "not the entry", so importing this module never starts the daemon.

Then change the guard line to `if (isEntryModule(process.argv[1], import.meta.url)) {`. Keep the main().catch(...) body byte-identical.

Hunk ownership:
- Do not touch parseArgs, main(), its switch or the `export { ... }` block. Sibling task-1d9a9651 owns main()'s dispatch, :1206-1253.
- Touch no other file. README, install-mac.sh, moe-agent.sh and docs need no change. superviseDaemon (:930/:945) re-spawns `_run` with process.argv[1], the link path, which the fixed guard accepts.

Re-run src/index.bin.test.ts in the snapshot: 7/7 green.
implementationPlan.note: Added exported isEntryModule(argv1, moduleUrl) above the entry guard in index.ts (as-written comparison first, then fs.realpathSync, catch returns false) and changed the guard to call it; main().catch body untouched. git diff: +18/-1, guard block only. Snapshot run of src/index.bin.test.ts: 7/7 green (was 7/7 red).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Realpath-only comparison: rejected as the sole check. Keeping today's as-written equality as the first branch makes regression impossible by construction; the realpath branch only adds runs the old guard refused. (2) A dedicated bin file (dist/bin.js that imports and runs main): rejected. It needs main() exported or moved, changes package.json bin and the bundles, and the direct `node dist/index.js` spawns (IDE, launchers, Docker) would still need a guard. (3) Path heuristics such as argv[1] ending in index.js or moe-daemon: rejected, because they give false positives when another entry imports this module. (4) fs.realpathSync.native: rejected. Node resolves the main entry with the JS realpathSync, and .native can differ in case or 8.3 form on Windows, which would break the equality. (5) Also fixing accounts/cli.ts invokedDirectly (:308-313) and benchmarks/baselineRun.ts:419: out of scope. Neither is the package bin; the IDE runs cli.js by the real path the daemon reports, and baselineRun is a repo script.
